title: WhatsApp Flow
summary: WhatsApp automation serves with consent — not spam broadcast

sections.heading: Orientation — Lesson Start

sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What will you understand?** WhatsApp automation for confirmations and FAQs — with confidence and **Consent**.

sections.heading: Core idea — Useful response + **Handoff**
sections.subtitle: Useful response + **Handoff**
sections.contentMarkdown:

- Message → understanding → response → if complicated: handoff to a staff member.
